pages.text: Stages one through five use finite item-only Kongqiao. Stage six unlocks aggregated Xianqiao items; fluids are Xianqiao-only. The storage key opens globally over most non-text screens and Escape returns to the prior screen.

The terminal supports smooth scrolling, localized name/tooltip/tag/namespace search, sorting, armor management and vanilla drag splitting. Items and fluids share one directory; fluid quantities display in buckets. The inventory remains a native Inventory layout for sorting helpers.

After Mekanism is installed, external chemical rows support container interaction: left-click the selected chemical with an empty chemical container to withdraw it, or right-click with a filled container to deposit its chemical into Xianqiao. The server validates the registered identity and live menu state transactionally, preserving stacked-container remainders when space is unavailable.

The built-in 3x3 grid refills from personal storage. Stage 4 unlocks embedded smithing with storage refill and JEI/EMI recipe transfer; furnace, equipment, fluids and magnet controls stay in the same continuous terminal.

The Xianqiao Management page controls personal-realm noon/midnight and clear/rain/thunder/snow states while showing boundary, time-scale and owner status. Snow is client-side visual only and never enables server precipitation across the realm.

The magnet directly stores drops in a 13x13x13 area. The inventory actions sort, insert all, or extract the filtered view. Hold Shift for exact amounts. Pressing E while typing in search no longer closes the terminal.
